== Style pass (2026-10-15) ==
=== Missing data ===
* Year pages linked from the homepage (1996–2007, including 2000 Worlds deck pages) have no Wayback CDX hits. The 2020 t.co snapshot is the surviving reading copy of the homepage.
=== Possibly faulty data ===
* Deck names differ: Blessed Souls labels Lapointe's 2000 Worlds decks "The Machine Killa" (LS) / "The Machine" (DS); the transcribed decklists on this wiki list Sokol as Hidden Base / ISB Operations and Lapointe as Mind What You Have Learned / Bring Him Before Me.
* 2000 European runner-up: this wiki lists [[Maarten Rossou]] (from Decipher Deck Designs); Blessed Souls spells it "Maarten Rousseau".
